book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Natauan babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Korin

content: Ebun akosarbuong tavuk ila kire gare la mime akosar inamaniap onim Israel na pianam la karuk ma inamaniap una

Ekelesiap papap tuam, narung meba mira maset gare ro: Na tara ang Moses, mirier eap buam la man omeuluan uriro uvau la uabu Morowa ga man masingiala o alang. Ga menum ga mumaio orupmaiaba Pirom Ula Taktogu.
Ga mirier ganam la maiaro nuvietiap iro uvau ga uriro pirom, ga uriro nuvietiap la mavuoieng ga ameuluan Moses ga betmeng inamaniap am.
Ga mirier ganam la maio iat uriro namurit parak la ualo Muranama a Morowa maun.
Ga mirier ganam la tapmaio o namurit it burunam la ualo Muranama a Morowa maun. Eva, iriro tadas ang iriro Muranama la tapmaio o burunam ana, la iat unum ga mirie. Iriro tadas irie Karisito.
Pa tale naong Morowa me tavuk maiang papot teip ga magaulap kabirana ma. Are ratmat ga makiraraong ga mevara na kimanam la karuk ma inamaniap una.
Ga miruo pagap ganam la betmeng ira ma la are uniap, meba busingala ga buat nabuong meba makosarbuong tavukup mila kiram, are tinan la makosarmeng.

Ga baraba lotuming me maun morowap o kakarabunim, are non ma la okosarmeng tinan. Are la umirmeng na Babam ula puaru maime gare ro, “Teip ga magaulap la maionama me parak ga tapnuap, tie temaiara ga mevina tapmat meba mavienmeng morowap o kakarabunim.”
Ga bubuo la buat akosarbuong tavuk o sadak are non ma la akosarmeng tinan, ga ot namurit la 23,000 ma teip ga magaulap la melum ga mevara.
Ga bubuo gat la buat avuvuobuong Ila Kani, gare non ma la okosarmeng ga kagokup mila kiram la makaratmeng ga mevara.
Ga mimi la buat tiesming o mukmuganim malonim a Morowa, are non ma la akosarmeng, ga angelo la ume makirara teip la muo ga makiraraong ga mevara.

Miriro pagap la betmeng ira ma, meba are ba uniap la masingmaiala non teip. Mamirmeng miriro gasip na babam ang Morowa, meba ialang agat buun bubuo teip la bunama na iruo tara titot. Irie tara la kagarat ara meba noba uriro kimanam.
Are ratmat ga migana la agatong kan ira a la dusong maranit, temamalienang maset babun ulum.

Uvuvuo la betieng ira mi, tale kan non ara. Karuk. Kainat gare uvuvuo la ime bet ira ma mirier inamaniap ganam. Pa Morowa la ume ouluan migat ties ang, eba tale airang uvuvuo ba meba okurupiling kukunim ming. Karuk. Leba betieng uvuvuo ira mi, eba orangaang Morowa non alang meba okabanming ga eba puoming meba dusming maranit na urie uvuvuo.
Baraba amiuluan Morowa ga muranap mila kiram iat gat
Are ratmat ga mimi papap tuam la narung maset, igoming aluo tavuk o lotu me mai morowap o kakarabunim ga mialam ibup mi ira ma.
Mirulo mimi gare teip ga magaulap la memaning agat ula muru. Are ratmat ga mimi kan le ovuvuoming ties tung la migat o karuk.
Me uriro falo la bume bivo temaieng me ai Morowa, atabo tale kan ime buipam ga olabuan a Karisito, a? Me uriro purun la bume opukobula, atabo tale kan ime buipam ga neip a Karisito, a?
Amet namurit purun ga bubuo ganam la bume parak o uriro namurit purun. Aret tie ga bubuo la bupapot ma teip ga magaulap, pa nebupam it na namurit neip.
Agatming tavuk maiang teip ga magaulap onim Israel. Tara la maio ngane la meburu nakap bo labun o lavang me ai Morowa, iriro tavuk la ume upamuam ga irio lavang.
Tiestung a man paga togo? Atabo tiestung me lavang maiang morowap o kakarabunim la irie paga migat, o morowap o kakarabunim mirie pagap mila kanim, a? Karuk.

Muana o tiestung la are ro: Paga la mime kamei teip la tale ameit Morowa a, mime kamei me mai muranap mila kiram. Tale kan kamei me aun Morowa. Are ratmat ga buat nebolaming meba miong uriro parak. Memani, tale narung le mipamang ga muranap mila kiram.

Tale kan puoieng meba iat tapmio na falo ang Ila Kakani ga na falo maiong muranap mila kiram gat. Ga tale kan puoieng meba iat parakming bo luaga ang Ila Kakani ga bo luaga ang muranama ila kire? Karuk.
Leba okosarbuong gare ro, tie atabo buga akosarbuong Ila Kakani meba kiram ba dalap a me bulam, a? Karuk. Atabo kukunim buong la okurupin kukunim ang ga akosarbuong iriro tavuk, a? Karuk.
Busit le man mialang bonim ula kanu aun Morowa

Non teip la tiesmeng gare ro, “Temaieng le makosarbuong mirier pagap ganam.” Pa tale mirier pagap ganam la mime buagamelie meba bumumurum ba maset. Mirier pagap la mumurum meba makosarbuong. Pa tale mirier pagap ganam la mime bukosar meba ongangasbuong nagan maiong papap ga loup buam.
Bubuo la buat agatbuong meba teagabulie kan ga bunang maset. Karuk. Bubuo le magatbuong gat non teip ga magaulap ga magabulie meba gat maionang maset.
Mirier pupunesip ga pagap ganam la mime masau na sune, mirie le miom. Buat agatming papot ga man umarikming tapmat. Karuk.
Memani, uriro kimanam ga mirier pagap ganam la dakmeng una, mirier ganam la am it Ila Kakani.

Pa leba mimarikang migana ba la tale naganong ira Iesu meba parakming ga irie, tie na kan ming la miga mila ga parakming. Buat agatming papot ga man umarikming tapmat na dalap mi, pa miom it mirier paparakiap la ualam miun.

Pa leba mialava iriro migana gare ro, “Urio puvu la o lavangmeng me maun morowap o kakarabunim”, tie, baraba mio. Memani, leba miong urio puvu, eba okosarming kiribas na irap a iriro migana la miulo ga eba giginam ba dalap a.

Turuo la tale kan tiestung maime dalap mi. Karuk. Tiestung me iriro non migana leba ogasangenang gare mimi la okosarming kiribas. Pa puorung it meba tom man pagap la narung maime. Memani, eba orouluan uvuvuo ang non migana me man paga meba tale akosartang?
Tie, leba tevang temaieng me aun Morowa ga eba tong paga ba, tie memani ga tiesong non migana kirat me rulam me iriro paga la tivo temaieng aime?
Are ratmat ga leba parakming ga tapmio o akosarming non paga, tie mimi le makosarming miriro pagap ganam meba mialang bonim ula kanu aun Morowa.
Temamalienming, ebun akosarming tavuk la ume masiki kibap ma Iudaiap ga Grikip ga mirier ekelesiap am Morowa ga melaming na kirinim.

Turuo gat la tume makosar mirier ubiap ganam puomeng me mirier teip meba nameng me mirier tavukup na nunumiap tung. Tale kan tume ubi gare ro meba teagaralie kan ga tonang maset. Pa tume ubi meba maagaralie papot ma teip ga magaulap meba ina malagiang Morowa.
